description: This file defines an extension on the String class adding a computed property 'nonEmpty' that returns an optional String. It trims whitespace and newlines and returns nil if the trimmed string is empty, otherwise returns the trimmed string.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: A computed property that trims whitespace and newline characters from the string and returns an optional String which is nil if the result is empty, otherwise the trimmed string.

search-terms: extending String with optional non-empty result
